source_name: MakeHuman hm08 base mesh, default skeleton and default weights (right hand extract)
modifications: Skin weights are MakeHuman's except across the web between thumb and index, where they are smoothed (build_settings.json thumb_web_smoothing; zero iterations restores the originals). The cut end of the forearm stub is closed with a dome that is not MakeHuman geometry (build_settings.json forearm_cap; zero rings gives a flat fan).
research_only_alternatives: MANO and SMPL-X hand models are research/non-commercial licences and are not bundled; they remain research-only alternatives.
